description: This file contains utility functions and classes for distributed checkpointing in PyTorch, including tensor shard handling, distributed communication wrappers, and checkpoint exception management.

classes.name: _DistWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around PyTorch's distributed process group providing collective communication methods with exception robustness.

classes.name: _ReaderView
classes.description: A file-like class that provides a view into a segment of a base stream.

methods.name: _get_failure_dict
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of failed wrapped exceptions from a list of results.

methods.name: _all_gather_keys
methods.description: Gathers all keys from local dictionaries across distributed processes.

methods.name: _assert_same_keys
methods.description: Asserts that all processes have the same keys in their state dictionaries.

methods.name: find_tensor_shard
methods.description: Finds and returns a specific shard of a tensor based on metadata index.

methods.name: find_state_dict_object
methods.description: Retrieves an object from a state dictionary, handling tensor shards if necessary.
